sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No published experience exists with miglustat during breastfeeding. Because of the lack of information and its side effect profile, most sources, including the manufacturer, consider breastfeeding to be contraindicated during maternal eliglustat therapy.
